title: Gutter Climb
reference: repeat 5 { while not wall_ahead { if tile_is y { jump } else { forward } } turn_right }
hints: The gutter spirals up. Yellow means a step up ahead, and every side is a different length.
Walk each side with a while. Inside it: on yellow jump, else forward. Turn right at the wall.
repeat 5 { while not wall_ahead { if tile_is y { jump } else { forward } } turn_right }

story.outro: PATCH: "Halfway up. I can see the drone lights from here."
